# Paths whose changes need close maintainer review before any merge.
# scripts/check-sensitive-paths.py reads this file; the triage bot applies the
# `sensitive-paths` label when a pull request touches any of them.
#
# Syntax: one glob per line, relative to the repository root. `*` matches within a
# path segment, `**` across segments, and a trailing `/` matches everything below a
# directory. `## ` lines name the category reported for the globs that follow.
